# Agents

The commands `mt help` lists under Agents. More in [Agents](../../../concepts/agents.md).

In a terminal, type `mt` and then the command. In the interactive shell and the cloud shell, type the command on
its own. `mt help <command>` shows the same details in your terminal.

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`agent-create`](#agent-create) | Create an agent from a model, a system prompt and a summary (with no tools: deploy a project for those) |
| [`agent-delete`](#agent-delete) | Delete an agent (refused while an interaction or router uses it, or a live run needs it) |
| [`agent-get`](#agent-get) | Show an agent by name: its latest version, how many tools it has, and its id |
| [`agent-list`](#agent-list) | List the agents in a namespace (every namespace when none is set) |
| [`agent-update`](#agent-update) | Change an agent: only what you give changes, the rest is kept from its latest version (a new version when anything differs) |

## agent-create

Create an agent from a model, a system prompt and a summary (with no tools: deploy a project for those).

```text
mt agent-create <name> [options]
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `<name>` | text | yes |  | The agent's name, unique in the namespace |

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--namespace, -ns <value>` | text |  |  | The namespace to use (default: your default namespace; see ns-get) |
| `--ai-model-id <id>` | id | yes |  | The id of the model it runs on (from aimodel-list) |
| `--system-prompt <value>` | text | yes |  | Its standing instructions (the system prompt) |
| `--summary <value>` | text | yes |  | One line that describes it to other agents: a router or manager choosing who to hand work to |

## agent-delete

Delete an agent (refused while an interaction or router uses it, or a live run needs it).

```text
mt agent-delete [name] [options]
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `<name>` | text |  |  | Name of the agent, or name@namespace (or give `--id` instead) |

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--namespace, -ns <value>` | text |  |  | The namespace to use (default: your default namespace; see ns-get) |
| `--id, -i <id>` | id |  |  | The agent's id, instead of its name |
| `--confirm` | flag |  |  | Delete it; without this the command only shows what would be deleted |

## agent-get

Show an agent by name: its latest version, how many tools it has, and its id.

```text
mt agent-get <name> [options]
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `<name>` | text | yes |  | Name of the agent to show |

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--namespace, -ns <value>` | text |  |  | The namespace to use (default: your default namespace; see ns-get) |

## agent-list

List the agents in a namespace (every namespace when none is set).

```text
mt agent-list [options]
```

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--namespace, -ns <value>` | text |  |  | The namespace to use (default: your default namespace; see ns-get) |

## agent-update

Change an agent: only what you give changes, the rest is kept from its latest version (a new version when anything differs).

```text
mt agent-update <name> [options]
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `<name>` | text | yes |  | Name of the agent to change |

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--namespace, -ns <value>` | text |  |  | The namespace to use (default: your default namespace; see ns-get) |
| `--new-name <value>` | text |  |  | A new name for the agent |
| `--ai-model-id <id>` | id |  |  | The id of a new model (from aimodel-list) |
| `--system-prompt <value>` | text |  |  | New standing instructions (the system prompt) |
| `--summary <value>` | text |  |  | A new one-line summary for other agents |
